description: Retrieval evaluation set for IncarnaMind v1 (issue #21). Kept for the 'Retrieval evaluation against the core' ticket.
hitRule: A question is a hit if one of the top 5 retrieved Passages (a) belongs to expected.document, (b) has a page range that covers expected.pages, and (c) contains expected.quote after both are normalised (src/text.ts normalize: NFKC, CJK radical folding, unified quotes/dashes/full-width punctuation, end-of-line hyphenation removed, whitespace collapsed, whitespace next to CJK characters removed).
pageNumbers: Physical 1-based page index as pdf.js reports it, not the printed page label.
core: The 20 questions without crossLingual: true (10 en, 10 zh) are the gating set. crossLingual questions are reported separately.

documents.language-models-are-unsupervised-multita: data/Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners.pdf
